content.short: Torus is a Web3-native key management infrastructure.
content.description: Torus is a Web3-native key management infrastructure backed by Binance, Aave, and other key industry players. It reduces the burden of private keys by using various authentication methods to derive users' keys, which they can consolidate multiple times as they wish. Developers building with the Torus API can integrate with any Web3 authentication provider, specifically Web3Auth.
